title: Silverado
description: Old West drifters Jake (Kevin Costner), Emmett (Scott Glenn), Mal and Paden (Kevin Kline) shoot it out with a crooked sheriff and clan.

title: The Missing
description: In 1885 a woman (Cate Blanchett) must join forces with her estranged father (Tommy Lee Jones) to rescue her kidnapped daughter (Evan Rachel Wood).

title: Fire on the Mountain
description: A developer (Ron Howard) helps an old rancher (Buddy Ebsen) defend land the Army wants for a missile base.

title: Nothing in Common
description: A yuppie adman (Tom Hanks) faces his parents' (Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint) separation and his father's need for a major operation.

title: Hanky Panky
description: Good guys and bad guys chase an architect (Gene Wilder) and a dead man's sister (Gilda Radner) for the wrong reason.

title: Against All Odds
description: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.

title: Felon
description: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: Conspiracy
description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears.

title: Toy Soldiers
description: When Colombian drug terrorists hold a Virginia prep school hostage, some of the rowdier boys (Sean Astin, Wil Wheaton, Keith Coogan) fight back.

title: Gridiron Gang
description: A counselor (The Rock) at a juvenile detention facility turns a group of young criminals into a football team to teach them self-respect and responsibility.

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: 7 Seconds

title: Solo

title: Jury Duty
description: A goof-off juror (Pauly Shore) stalls a trial to take advantage of his lifestyle being paid for by the court.

title: Lone Star State of Mind
description: A Texas mechanic tries to save a dimwitted relative from gangsters.

title: Quicksilver

title: Tortured

title: Steel Magnolias

title: First Knight
description: King Arthur (Sean Connery) loves Guinevere (Julia Ormond) and tries to keep her from the clutches of Lancelot (Richard Gere) and a land-grabber.

description: When Frederick Wentworth -- the one who got away -- crashes back into Anne Elliot's life, she must choose between putting the past behind her or listening to her heart when it comes to second chances.
